title: Perfect complexes are compact in the quasi-coherent derived category
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Every perfect object P [def-pc-perfect-complex] of D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X) [def-pc-derived-category] is compact: for every set I and family (K_i) in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X), the canonical map \bigoplus_{i\in I} \operatorname{Hom}(P,K_i) \to \operatorname{Hom}(P,\bigoplus_{i\in I}K_i) is an isomorphism.
